resetSemantics: Each independent route starts once at its grounded C0 soil entry; subsequent movement between platforms, markers, ladder endpoints and continuous gallery crossings uses updatePlayer without per-hop pose placement. Jump retries restore only the same takeoff state. Reverse-route fallback restores the reached reward state, searches alternatives, then replays actual input frames without pose placement; those returns reject automatic furnished supports.
